Total 192 trees across all treatments.

recon.extraction_guidance: PRIMARY TARGETS: Tables 3 (current-year needles) and Table 4 (previous-year needles) contain foliar mineral concentration data. Figure 3 shows throughfall leaching data (not foliar concentrations) - do not use for primary mineral concentration outcomes. The paper explicitly found: elevated CO2 significantly decreased K and P in current-year needles; no significant effect on previous-year needles for most elements; O3 decreased C and N but had minimal effect on other minerals.
